description: Tasks template for modernization plan. Generate this file alongside plan.md to track individual migration tasks.

tasks.description: Externalize hardcoded sensitive data and connection configuration to Azure-native configuration services. Addresses issues: Hardcoded sensitive data detected, Connection strings without configuration builders detected.
tasks.reason: Assessment findings show sensitive values and connection strings are currently defined in source/configuration files, which is not cloud-ready.
tasks.requirements: Migrate hardcoded sensitive values from code/config into Azure Key Vault and move non-secret runtime configuration to centralized Azure configuration management. Use Managed Identity for service authentication and preserve existing runtime behavior while reading values from externalized sources.

tasks.description: Scan dependencies for CVEs and remediate discovered vulnerabilities before deployment.
tasks.reason: Security remediation is required in every modernization plan to ensure dependencies are not left with known vulnerabilities.
tasks.requirements: Upgrade vulnerable dependencies to patched versions. If remediation needs major-version upgrades, document impacted packages and breaking-change risk. Verify the project builds and tests pass after remediation.
